text: I'm so sorry to message this late, I really hope this isn't wasting anyone's time. I'm a childminder and have a little girl, 23 months, staying overnight with me while her parents are away. Her temperature was 37.9 earlier. In between her doses of paracetamol she's honestly fine, playing with her toys, drinking her milk and water, chatting away to me. She just will not settle to sleep tonight, keeps sitting up wanting to play. There's been no fit or shaking or jerking at all, and I've checked her all over and there's no rash anywhere. I just feel responsible because she isn't mine and I want to do everything right. Sorry again
